entities.name: Joachim Hämmerling
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Dr. Joachim Hämmerling was a pioneering Danish-German biologist funded by Nazi Germany who determined that the nucleus of a cell controls the development of organisms. His experimentation with the green algae Acetabularia provided a model subject for modern cell biological research, and proved the existence of morphogenetic substances, or mRNP.
